About Special

Over 20 Years of Experience. Built on Trust.

Special Air Cond and Car Accessories Centre is Parit Raja's first automotive air-conditioning and car accessories centre. With more than 20 years of experience, the business has served the local community with automotive services and accessories.

Alongside retail services for vehicle owners, the centre also supplies automotive accessories wholesale to local businesses and fellow industry operators.
